description: This source file contains JNI (Java Native Interface) code for managing EGL display, context, and surface objects in Android's OpenGL ES environment. It includes functions for initializing class references, converting between Java objects and native EGL handles, and caching method IDs.

methods.name: nativeClassInit
methods.description: Initializes global references to EGL-related Java classes and caches method and field IDs for later use.

methods.name: fromEGLHandle
methods.description: Converts a Java EGL object to its native EGL handle (pointer).

methods.name: toEGLHandle
methods.description: Creates a Java EGL object from a native EGL handle, returning special objects for EGL_NO_CONTEXT, EGL_NO_DISPLAY, and EGL_NO_SURFACE.
